problems: Negotiation of delivery date = 협의 (Table 2 5급 총괄), vocabulary '유예', '만전을 기하다' is above 4급; grade too low.
Hint 1 describes the answer; hint 2 quotes it; d is also contradicted only by '일주일만'.
vi prompt loses dialogue; en blank reads 'if you could please ____' then option repeats 'a one-week' (cloze reading awkward).
'납기를 유예' unnatural; '납기를 연장/연기해 주시면' more natural.
decisions.fix: Re-grade to 5급 or simplify; replace 유예 with 연기; keep dialogue in all translations; fix hints.

problems: Option a promises compensation immediately, contradicting the manual in kr-rev-076 (apologize, investigate, then compensate) and common practice.
Near-duplicate of 076 and the same 'pick polite among rude' template as 077-079; distractors b-d are rude strawmen.
Hint 2 quotes the answer; en 'caused by delay' awkward; vi b-d truncated.
decisions.fix: Change a to '확인 후 적절한 조치를 취하겠습니다'; differentiate from 076; merge or drop one of 077-081.

problems: Speaker's rank not given: '박 과장' (b) is acceptable when the speaker is higher; key is only right for equal/lower speaker.
Hint 1 spells out the formula 부서명+성+직급+님, which equals option a.
vi translations: option a glossed with Korean parenthetical, b-d left as raw Korean; en 'Park-gun' unexplained (answer marking, mixed text).
c/d absurd.
decisions.fix: State speaker is a 대리 or same-level; make distractors plausible (박 과장님께서, 박 과장님 님); standardize translations.

problems: Ordering item labelled domain 쓰기(어순): not a writing/production assessment; relabel as 문법·어순 배열 (recognition), Table 6 does not apply.
Chips are listed w1-w5 already in the correct order and the answer is w1..w5; if options are displayed in stored order the puzzle is pre-solved (shuffle required).
Not uniquely determined: '파일로' is a free adverbial ('파일로 요청하신 검토 의견서를 첨부하여...'); '요청하신 검토 의견서를 첨부하여 파일로 송부해 드립니다' also natural; hint 1 gives the whole order.
'첨부하여 ... 송부' semantically redundant; en/vi translation gives the finished sentence as meaning.
decisions.fix: Shuffle options; reduce free-scrambling (e.g., fix 파일로 first via phrase chip), accept alternate orders in answer set, relabel domain, shorten hint 1.
decisions.blindNote: Alt order also acceptable: w3,w1,w2,w4,w5 (파일로 요청하신 검토 의견서를 첨부하여 송부해 드립니다). Scrambled-order ambiguity.

problems: Word order not unique: time/place/object adverbials scramble freely ('대회의실에서 차주 화요일 오전 10시에 회의를 진행하겠습니다', '회의를 차주 화요일...' all natural); key is a convention, not the only natural order.
Hint 1 reveals the full order (leak); chips already stored in answer order.
Mislabelled 쓰기(어순) - not writing production; basic word order is 2-3급, not 4급 (Table 6 4급 row 2 requires formal text production).
'차주' + '진행하겠습니다' fine but trivial.
decisions.fix: Hold; redesign with one-correct-order constraint (e.g., 이다/-에서 chains, modifier-noun order) or drop.

problems: Splitting noun phrase '양사의 상호 발전' into three chips makes ordering partly lexical-chunk (alternate '상호 양사의' marginal); '긴밀한 협력을 양사의 상호 발전을 위해' unnatural, so near-unique but not guaranteed.
Hint 1 gives full order; chips stored in answer order; label 쓰기(어순) must be recast as ordering practice.
'희망합니다' is stiff; '기대합니다/바랍니다' more natural.
decisions.fix: Merge '양사의 상호' chip, shuffle, list accepted variants, rename domain.

problems: Key not unique: '고객 만족도가 전 분기 대비 12% 상승하였습니다' is at least as natural; 대폭 can precede 12%.
Key '12% 대폭 상승' is unnatural/contradictory ('대폭' with a modest 12%).
Hint 1 gives whole order; chips stored in answer order; mislabeled as writing.
decisions.fix: Hold; remove 대폭 and fix topic-comment anchor, or convert to something with a single order.
decisions.blindNote: Ambiguous: '대폭 12% 상승' vs '12% 대폭 상승' (my pick: w1,w2,w4,w3,w5). Pairing 대폭 with an exact percentage is slightly unnatural; adverb placement is not fixed, so w1,w2,w3,w4,w5 is arguably also acceptable. Also '전 분기 대비' could precede or follow subject.

problems: Basic -(으)시-/께서 agreement is early-intermediate (1-3급), not 4급; no Table 3-6 row supports it.
b is grammatical (only lacks honorific), so stem '호응이 바르게' needs '높임이 바르게'; c/d are ungrammatical for unrelated reasons (particles).
Hint 1 names 께서/-시- (answer).
decisions.fix: Use 간접높임 contrast (시간이 있으십니다 vs 계십니다) or 압존법; make all distractors differ only in honorific agreement.

problems: Stem names '여쭙다' but options use '여쭈어보았습니다' (여쭈다); mismatch.
Options b-d combine two errors each; c uses 드리다 wrongly with grandmother as agent, partially testing a different point.
Translations: en/vi translate only option a, leaving b-d as truncated Korean ('동생에게 선물을 드리고...'), a gloss leak.
Hint 2 reveals the rule's negative.
decisions.fix: Align verb forms; give each distractor a single error; translate all options.

problems: '저희/우리' is basic (2급) vocabulary; claiming 5급 K8/4급 unsupported; textbook-typical item.
b/c/d trivially wrong ('우리들 회사' nonsensical); '당신 회사' refers to others' company, not the question.
Business Korean uses 당사/자사/폐사; '저희 회사' is acceptable but not the formal norm.
Hint 2 gives answer; en/vi gloss only on a (leak).
decisions.fix: Retarget to 당사/폐사 vs 귀사 (own vs other company), grade at 4-5급, translate all options equally.

problems: '자리에 착석해' is redundant (착석 already means sit in seat); better '자리에 앉아 주시기 바랍니다'.
d is also polite (해요체), c ungrammatical ('자리 앉을래'); hint 1 states the -(으)시기 바랍니다 form.
Item is announcement register but text-only; do not claim listening.
en/vi use 'Hasipsio-style' jargon and gloss only on a.
decisions.fix: Fix redundancy, make hint 1 about 격식체 only, remove jargon and asymmetric glosses.
decisions.blindNote: '착석해 주시기 바랍니다' is a 하십시오체-style request (-ㅂ니다) but 착석 + 자리에 is redundant; wrong options are blatantly rude/other speech levels, so stem is easy. Option d (해요체) is not 하십시오체.

problems: Short, simple passage and answer is a direct paraphrase; distractors are extreme absolutes (무제한, 아무런, 즉시 중단) so solvable without reading; more like Table 5 4급 row 3 than 5급.
Option a is long and copy-based; hint 1 lists answer content.
vi/en distractors truncated, shortening them and making them clearly absurd.
decisions.fix: Add a longer passage with a counter-argument and plausible but partial distractors; re-check against 5급 row 3/5.

problems: Fits Table 5 5급 row 3/4 (logic flow, 논설문). Negative stem is clearly marked; unique key. Minor: vi option c omits 공감 능력; hint 2 states key (acceptable as final hint).
decisions.fix: Optionally add 공감 to vi c and bold 않는 in stem.

problems: Hint 1 lists the three true tasks (elimination leak) and hint 2 names the answer; hint says '3대 과제' but explanation lists four.
Distractor a is absurd and not even plausibly mentioned; 'negative stem' reduces to spotting the odd item.
'돌봄 경제(Care Economy)' English term in Korean target text is fine, but 'it is Table 5 5급 row 1/4 appropriate.'
decisions.fix: Make the false option a plausible policy not in the text (e.g., 돌봄 서비스의 전면 민영화); reword hints.

problems: en/vi translated prompt gives the answer: "('However')" / "('Tuy nhiên')" (direct answer leak).
Hint 1 names 역접; hint 2 says 'however'.
그러나 is best but 그러므로/게다가 not clearly impossible; shift is mild (stronger with '하지만 이 인기를 지속하려면').
Common textbook connective item.
decisions.fix: Remove gloss from translated prompt; sharpen blank context; drop hint 2 translation.

problems: Sentence contains '마당발', which is synonym of 발이 넓다 and gives away the meaning; '각계각층' also cues.
Common textbook idiom; same format as 096/097 (three near-duplicate body-idiom items).
Embedded <u> HTML tag in plain text; renderer may show it literally.
Idiom is intermediate (3-4급), not 5급.
decisions.fix: Remove 마당발, avoid HTML, use bold/brackets; combine 095-097 or differentiate.

problems: Common textbook idiom (귀가 얇다) in same template as 095/097.
Embedded <u> tag; hint 2 restates key; 4급-level idiom for 5급.
d (귀 병) trivial.
decisions.fix: Use 귀가 얇다 vs 귀가 가렵다 type near-synonyms; no HTML; merge with 095/097 set.

problems: '손이 크다' also (in some use) can mean spending-generous; a is composite of two senses (씀씀이 + 음식) but ok.
Same template as 095/096; <u> tag; context with '상다리가 부러지도록' is an extra idiom above learner level.
Hint 2 points to the context phrase (leak).
decisions.fix: Simplify context; avoid HTML; deduplicate with 095/096.

problems: Hint 2 paraphrases the proverb ('소를 잃어버린 후에야 축사를 고치는 격'): effectively the answer.
Translations: gloss on option a only; b-d untranslated Korean. Distractors unrelated, solvable by elimination.
Very common textbook proverb.
decisions.fix: Use plausible distractors (같은 주제: 뒤늦은 후회 vs 예방 속담, e.g., 유비무환), symmetric glosses.

problems: The prompt is almost a restatement of the proverb; hint 2 explicitly links 가는 말/오는 말; vi/en glosses only on a.
Classic textbook proverb (3-4급), too-high grade for 5급.
c ('말 한마디로 천 냥 빚') partially overlaps the 'good speech' theme; acceptable but weaker discrimination.
decisions.fix: Rephrase scenario instead of defining; symmetric translations; regrade 4급.

problems: Hanja in options and hint 1 ('쓴 것이 다하면 단 것이 온다') plus hint 2 '고생 끝에 낙이 온다' give the answer; en prompt "'Sweetness comes after bitterness is exhausted'" and vi prompt 'Khổ tận cam lai' directly leak the key.
Other options are unrelated, plain elimination; textbook-typical item.
Hanja 苦盡甘來 appearing only in a-gloss pattern mixed with learner text.
decisions.fix: Remove hanja gloss from prompt translations, replace hints with context, add plausible distractors (e.g., 새옹지마, 전화위복).
